documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for The Quarter Ended On June 30, 2026.
Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong performance for Q4 and FY26 with robust growth in revenue and profitability despite supply chain and input cost challenges from geopolitical tensions. The company highlighted strategic reductions in low-margin wheel assembly business, progress in captive solar energy projects, and new product ventures like alloy wheels and sunroofs. Looking ahead to FY27, the company remains optimistic about mid-teens growth supported by policy reforms and new product lines. ASK Automotive Limited reported its financial results for the quarter and financial year ended March 31, 2026, highlighting strong consolidated revenue, EBITDA, and PAT growth that outperformed the industry. Management noted the impact of passthrough alloy prices and strategic reduction in low value-added wheel assembly business on margins, alongside ongoing transitions to renewable energy with captive solar plants.

guidance.claim: The company is confident of growing around mid-teens in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are confident that will continue to grow around mid-teens in FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: The independent aftermarket segment grew by 24.7% in FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: Happy to share that our independent aftermarket has grown by 24.7% in FY26.

demand_outlook.claim: OEM customers are carrying on with their original production schedules.
demand_outlook.quote: As far outlook of the two-wheeler industry is concerned, our all our OEM customers they are carrying on with their original production schedules which shows a nice growth in this year also and none of the supplies have been affected by the raw materials or anything.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects to invest around Rs. 400 Cr in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: For next year growth of mid-teens, we need to invest around RS.400 Cr which we shall be investing in this year also.

capex_expansion.claim: The second captive solar plant in Bikaner is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatt in Bikaner, Rajasthan is progressing well and is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27, this reflects ASK's special focus on green energy.

capex_expansion.claim: A 9.9 MWp captive solar power plant was commissioned in Sirsa, Haryana.
capex_expansion.quote: 9.9 MWp captive solar power plant commissioned in Sirsa, Haryana

capex_expansion.claim: The company entered into a technical collaboration with Kyushu Yanagawa Seiki Co., Ltd. (KYSK), Japan, for motorcycle wheels with aluminium die-cast technology.
capex_expansion.quote: Entered into a technical collaboration with Kyushu Yanagawa Seiki Co., Ltd. (KYSK), Japan, a leading supplier of motorcycle wheels with aluminium die-cast technology

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q4 FY26 was impacted by 80 basis points due to pass-through alloy prices.
margins_costs.quote: For this impact, EBITDA percentage would have been higher by 80 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA percentage for FY26 would have been higher by 40 bps absent the passthrough alloy prices impact.
margins_costs.quote: But for this impact EBITDA percentage would have been higher by 40 bps.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the Bangalore plant has reached 90%.
orders_capacity.quote: Very, very happy to share that Bangalore we have reached 90% capacity utilization that we set up last year, our 18th plant and the third plant in Bengaluru.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the Karoli plant is currently at 65%.
orders_capacity.quote: In the Karoli plant, the capacities utilization is still 65%, that is the reason that we have made investment for the alloy wheels.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has 18 state of the art manufacturing facilities.
orders_capacity.quote: 18 State of the art Manufacturing Facilities
Backed by 18 strategically located manufacturing facilities near customer locations, ASK enables just-in-time delivery, supply chain efficiency, and world-class quality standards.

capital_allocation.claim: The board recommended a dividend of 92.5%, amounting to Rs. 1.85 per equity share.
capital_allocation.quote: The board has recommended a dividend of 92.5%, that is Rs. 1.85 per equity share of face value of Rs. 2 each.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflict in West Asia has disrupted the global economy and affected the Indian economy.
risks_headwinds.quote: After 28th February, 2026, geopolitical conflict in West Asia has disrupted the global economy, posing an unprecedented challenge in supply chain, creating undue volatility in energy, commodity and currency across the globe and it has started affecting Indian economy as well.

risks_headwinds.claim: Revenue from exports was impacted by trade disruptions, higher tariff rates, geopolitical tensions, and supply chain issues.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our revenue from exports were at Rs. 141 Cr in FY26 against Rs. 147 Cr last year because of the trade disruptions due to higher tariff rates, geopolitical tensions, supply chain issues, logistic costs and other bottlenecks.

management_commitments.claim: The second captive solar plant in Bikaner is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatt in Bikaner, Rajasthan is progressing well and is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27, this reflects ASK's special focus on green energy.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects alloy wheel revenue of around Rs. 90 - Rs. 100 Cr in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: FY27 we are expecting revenue of around Rs. 90 - Rs. 100 Cr and FY28 will be about Rs. 220 Cr.

management_commitments.claim: The company will be spending about Rs. 400 Cr in capex for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: FY27 we'll be spending about Rs. 400 Cr.

management_commitments.claim: With effect from April 1, 2026, wheel assembly sales will be nil.
management_commitments.quote: With effect from 01.04.2026, WA sales will be Nil

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
